messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 5xxs for /v1/prompt-route (region: us-west-2). error-rate 12% over 3m, latency p95 up 600ms. paging mira (oncall). :rotating_light:
mira (oncall): On it. Paging myself, pulling graphs. Is this from the new prompt-route endpoint rollout?
julian (eng-runtime): Saw similar in logs, looks like an NPE in prompt-transformer when payload omitted optional metadata. Happened after midnight deploy of prompt-route-v3 canary.
mira (oncall): Can we revert route to stable variant while we triage? I want minimal customer impact.
julian (eng-runtime): Agreed. Two options: 1) flip feature flag to route back to prompt-route-v2 (fast), 2) roll back canary servers (slower, connection drain). Recommend flag flip.
ops-bot: Reminder: feature flags can be toggled via Admin UI or API. API call:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"prompt_route_v3_enabled","value":false}'
```
mira (oncall): I'm going to flip the flag now. Announcing to channel before action.
mira (oncall): Executing: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/toggle -d '{"flag":"prompt_route_v3_enabled","value":false}'` (masked token)
support-bot: Note: Support queue shows 14 new tickets with similar errors in last 10m. Tagging bethany (support).
bethany (support): Thanks. I'll surface a short status to affected customers and add link to incident doc. How long to expect degraded behavior to stop after toggle?
mira (oncall): Metrics should normalize within one minute of switching traffic, cache warmups aside. Watching now.
ops-bot: Feature flag toggle acknowledged by system (tx id: tf-9a3b). Routing policy reverted to prompt-route-v2.
julian (eng-runtime): Seeing immediate drop in 5xxs on canary hosts, p95 returning to baseline. Nice. Need to capture stack traces and reproduce locally.
mira (oncall): Customer impact window estimate: ~12 minutes from initial spike to mitigation. bethany, suggest message: "We've reverted an experimental routing change; some requests between 05:12-05:24 UTC returned errors. No data loss. We're investigating root cause."
bethany (support): Drafting now. Will post to status page + CS queue.
deploy-bot: deploy logs: canary deploy prompt-route-v3 @ 2026-03-15T05:09:01Z -> 7 instances. New route config includes optional-header parsing change.
julian (eng-runtime): Here's a minimal repro from logs (stack):
```
NullPointerException at Transformer.apply(Transformer.java:134)
  at Router.handle(Router.java:88)
  at RequestProcessor.process(RequestProcessor.java:47)
```
julian (eng-runtime): Looks like unexpected null when metadata.header_x is absent. We'll add guard + unit test.
mira (oncall): I'm handing this to julian for full postmortem and fix. Nate (sre-lead) loop in for follow-up capacity checks.
mira (oncall): Handoff: i've toggled the flag, verified p95 stabilized, customer notifications queued. Leaving channel; ping if things regress. :white_check_mark:
nate (sre-lead): Thanks. I'll run a brief audit of autoscaling and cache priming. If we need rollback of image we'll coordinate.
julian (eng-runtime): I'll create a branch with guard fix + add a canary-test that simulates missing metadata header. Will also add a quick non-disruptive e2e for route parsing.
bethany (support): Posted on status.redwood.com: "Partial outage for advanced prompt routing affecting some requests 05:12-05:24 UTC. Reverted experimental route. Engineers investigating; follow-up with root cause and timeline." Sent to 18 customers in impacted cohort.
support-bot: Created ticket thread #INC-3421 linking logs and affected customer IDs.
mira (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated. Leaving note: mitigation = flag toggle -> stable route. Next: postmortem + test coverage.
julian (eng-runtime): Taking ownership of follow-up. I'll file a remediation PR and link to postmortem doc.
ops-bot: Recommend canary policy tweak: hold step size at 10% and add schema validation in rollout pipeline.
nate (sre-lead): Agreed. I'll own rollout policy updates.
mira (oncall): Closing live incident thread. If any regression occurs, reopen and @mira.
julian (eng-runtime): Thanks all. Adding channel summary to pagerduty incident and moving to #postmortems for root cause writeup."
